audience: Australian businesses that ship parcels with Transdirect couriers

useCases.title: Compare courier prices for a parcel
useCases.text: Look up the suburb and postcode of each address. Get courier quotes for the parcel. Quotes create a draft booking only, and nothing is paid.

useCases.title: Pay for a booking after approval
useCases.text: List the saved payment methods. After the user approves the courier, the price and the payment method, confirm the draft booking. Transdirect charges that payment method.

useCases.title: Print a label and track a parcel
useCases.text: Get a signed link to the label PDF of a booking. Track a shipment by its reference or connote to see its state and events.

useCases.title: Review recent bookings
useCases.text: List the bookings since a date. Then open one booking to read its status, payment flag, courier and cost.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking after approval
useCases.text: Cancel a booking after the user approves it. Transdirect applies its own refund, courier cancellation or support escalation.
